name: hud_ui_save_load_refresh_file_list
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::RefreshSaveFileList rebuilds the save file vector from SavedGames and orders entries newest-first.
known_limits: Local VC COFF byte target covers 0x4355e0, but tier S remains blocked by 936 unmasked mismatches after 80 relocation-masked bytes and 15 trimmed VC NOPs.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4355e0 validates HudUiSaveLoadEntries at self+0xc9fc, clearing the vector through the no-op destroy erase helper before resetting end to begin, FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA over SavedGames\*.*, filtering FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY, appending WIN32_FIND_DATAA-shaped entries, partial quicksort via PartitionEntriesByPivot/SortEntryRange for ranges over 16 entries, and final newest-first insertion sort.
The native smoke creates four SavedGames files plus a directory, refreshes a bounded save-entry vector, verifies the directory is ignored, and verifies entries are ordered by write time newest-first.
